method_note: Polygons are read from the IMRO 2012 GML of zoning plan NL.IMRO.1911.BPAgriportB1-va02 (Gemeente Hollands Kroon, EPSG:28992). gml:Surface/PolygonPatch rings are assembled from LineStringSegment and Arc segments; each Arc is densified to 32 segments on the circle through its three control points. The 'specifieke vorm van bedrijventerrein - 1' function designation is subtracted from the Bedrijventerrein land-use polygon with shapely 2.1.1, the planar area centroid is taken in EPSG:28992, and it is transformed to EPSG:4326 with pyproj 3.7.1 (default transformation) and rounded to 7 decimals. The BAG verblijfsobject point for Westlanderweg 50 is used as published (WFS, EPSG:4326) only to check which part of the plan holds the existing AMS-E campus.

candidates.decision: Selected the planar area centroid of the part of the Bedrijventerrein (business park) land-use zone of the adopted zoning plan 'Uitbreiding Agriport A7, Deelgebied B1' that lies outside the 'specifieke vorm van bedrijventerrein - 1' designation (the designation that holds Microsoft's existing AMS-E campus at Westlanderweg 50) as the campus locator for Microsoft's Campus West expansion on Deelgebied B1, replacing the OpenStreetMap point.
candidates.layer: IMRO 2012 plan NL.IMRO.1911.BPAgriportB1-va02, 'Uitbreiding Agriport A7, Deelgebied B1' (locatieNaam 'Cultuurweg Middenmeer'), bronbeheerder Gemeente Hollands Kroon, vastgesteld 2022-09-15 (besluitnummer 2017/1383), EPSG:28992

facts.developer_plot_size: Microsoft's notitie reikwijdte en detailniveau (Ramboll, 23 December 2025) gives Deelgebied B1 as about 53 ha west of the A7 on Cultuurweg, directly north of the existing AMS-E campus; the polygon used covers 55.87 ha
facts.other_plan_layers_not_used: Maatvoering maximum bouwhoogte (25.95 ha, inside Bedrijventerrein), Gebiedsaanduiding wetgevingzone - wijzigingsgebied 2 (6.30 ha, inside Bedrijventerrein), Leiding - Hoogspanning and Waarde - Archeologie

candidates.exclusions: The OpenStreetMap way behind the previous point was not used. The PDOK Locatieserver was not queried (robots.txt disallows it). No map viewer, geocoder or map link was used.
